objective: Spherical conformal telegrapher lapse with stage characteristic tracking; robust convergence of the lapse front and unprojected Hamiltonian errors.

equations.interpretation: Flat-reference spherical contraction and componentwise advection. This is an explicit conformal coordinate gauge, not a literal coordinate transform of the Cartesian physical telegrapher equation.
equations.support: Fixed C7 flat-top window, inner=.01, outer=.8, transition=.08. Coupling and forcing vanish identically in endpoint collars.
equations.characteristics: -beta +/- sqrt(chi*(F+kappa*w^2/tau)), with F=alpha^2+4 nu Omega^2 alpha. Auxiliary advected mode=-beta. Frozen lapse-trace-flux calculation only; free Z4c remains independent.
equations.chart: Full AF logarithmic coefficient chart; added physical conformal lapse rate divided by total alpha in the stored log lapse; no differential constraint projection or lapse floor. Auxiliary B remains unscaled.

verification_before_pilots: Independent Python/compiled nonzero-flux rates and RK stages with independently nonzero constraints
Cartesian radial tensor contraction identity, including both angular terms
Zero-kappa, zero-B bitwise agreement with original geometry integrator
Checkpoint preservation of geometry, B, rays and all compensated low parts
Reference equilibrium and exact-zero endpoint coupling
Characteristic activation, integration accuracy and restart checks

pilots.purpose: Reject unstable/ineffective cases and select candidates; pilots cannot complete the objective.

acceptance.resolutions: At least three related grids, initially 513/1025/2049; refine farther if asymptotic convergence is unresolved.
acceptance.front: Compare physical lapse and its gradient over the complete transient. Gradient peak must stabilize with refinement, not grow like 1/h. Inter-grid finest gradient discrepancy below 10% after matched spatial comparison.
acceptance.constraints: Full-domain H,M,Theta,Z over all accepted states, plus RK-stage safety/compatibility. No inner masking or endpoint-only acceptance.
acceptance.independent_controls: Middle-grid dt,dt/2,dt/4; time error below 10% spatial error. Independent shift quadrature and KO variations. Adjacent fixed continuum tau/kappa values must retain convergence; never tune damping with h to manufacture a pass.
acceptance.positivity: alpha,chi>0 at every physical node and RK stage
acceptance.invariant_mass: Track Misner-Sharp and horizon mass independently; small mass drift cannot override failed constraints.
acceptance.characteristics: Advance both gauge families and log ray-map Jacobians with RK-stage geometry. Compare across spatial/time refinement; terminal boundary exits are not crossings. A finite-grid interpolant cannot prove continuum crossing.

status: Declared before nonlinear telegrapher pilots. Original failures and paused historical jobs remain preserved.
